nodes.name: GND
nodes.semantic_role: System common ground (star-ground intent for analog/digital separation)

nodes.name: power_digital_3v3
nodes.description: TPS54331 buck converter generates digital rail VCC_3V3_D from VIN_5V. EN input must be configured for enable policy (e.g., tied to VIN_5V). VSENSE feedback network must be implemented downstream for output regulation. COMP pin is for compensation network. BOOT and SS pins need passive implementation per datasheet. This module is the sole provider of VCC_3V3_D.

nodes.name: BOOT
nodes.description: Bootstrap capacitor connection for high-side MOSFET gate drive

nodes.name: EN
nodes.description: Enable input, active high, <1.25V disables device, float to enable

nodes.name: SS
nodes.description: Soft-start programming pin, external capacitor sets output rise time

nodes.name: VSENSE
nodes.description: Inverting input of transconductance error amplifier, feedback sensing node

nodes.name: COMP
nodes.description: Error amplifier output and PWM comparator input, connect frequency compensation components

nodes.name: PH
nodes.description: Switch node, source of internal high-side power MOSFET

nodes.name: power_analog_3v3
nodes.description: ME6211 LDO generates analog/sensor rail VCC_3V3_A from VIN_5V. CE input must be configured for enable policy (e.g., tied to VIN_5V). VSS (ground) is common GND. This module is the sole provider of VCC_3V3_A; rail is kept distinct from digital rail.

nodes.name: CE
nodes.description: Chip Enable. ME6211C: active high (>=1.0V ON). Tie to VIN for always-on.

nodes.name: mcu_core
nodes.description: STM32F427 MCU. It connects to IMU via I2C, and to barometer and Flash via shared SPI with separate chip-selects. Must configure boot mode pins for Flash boot. MCU requires power from both digital and analog rails: core/logic uses VCC_3V3_D; ADC and sensor interface may use VCC_3V3_A. This module owns I2C and SPI bus biasing/pull-up policy.

nodes.name: imu_mpu6050
nodes.description: MPU-6050 6-axis IMU. I2C slave; AD0 pin configurable for address selection (tie to GND/VCC). INT output to MCU optional. CLKIN optional for external clock; REGOUT for internal regulator output (1.8V) not used here. No pull-ups on I2C bus (owned by MCU). Powered by analog rail.

nodes.name: AUX_DA
nodes.description: I2C master serial data for connecting external sensors (e.g. magnetometer).

nodes.name: AUX_CL
nodes.description: I2C master serial clock output for connecting external sensors.

nodes.name: CS
nodes.description: SPI chip select, active low. Tie to VDD for I2C mode.

nodes.name: AD0
nodes.description: I2C address LSB. GND=0x68, VDD=0x69. SPI mode: SDO output.

nodes.name: REGOUT
nodes.description: Internal regulator output. Connect 0.1uF capacitor to GND.

nodes.name: FSYNC
nodes.description: Frame synchronization input. Connect to GND if unused.

nodes.name: INT
nodes.description: Interrupt output, configurable as push-pull or open-drain.

nodes.name: CPOUT
nodes.description: Charge pump capacitor connection. Connect 2.2nF capacitor to GND.

nodes.name: baro_bmp280
nodes.description: BMP280 barometric pressure sensor. SPI slave; CSB pin is chip-select. VDDIO and VDD both powered by analog rail. No pull-ups on SPI bus (owned by MCU).

nodes.name: VDDIO
nodes.description: Interface supply 1.2-3.6V. Level for digital I/O.

nodes.name: CSB
nodes.description: SPI chip select (active low). Tie to VDDIO for I2C mode.

nodes.name: SDO
nodes.description: SPI data out. In I2C: address bit (GND=0x76, VDDIO=0x77).

nodes.name: flash_w25q128
nodes.description: W25Q128JV SPI NOR Flash. SPI slave; CS pin is chip-select. WP and HOLD pins need configuration (e.g., tied to VCC for normal operation). Powered by digital rail.

nodes.name: WP
nodes.description: Write Protect, active low (IO2 in Quad). Tie to VCC if unused.

nodes.name: HOLD
nodes.description: Hold/Reset, active low (IO3 in Quad). Tie to VCC if unused.
